parsed.rationale: Both participating records have `is_test: true` and reside in the same test file `Shared/Playback/Tests/PlaybackTests/Behavior/AudioPlayerBehaviorTests.swift`. Although the Jaccard similarity is 0.7, the two methods belong to distinct test classes (`AudioPlayerCoreStateTests` and `AudioPlayerIdempotencyTests`) and verify different behavioural properties: one asserts that `isPlaying` is false after a stop, while the other asserts that a play-after-stop sequence works correctly. The structural similarity is incidental to the shared test setup pattern (stop-then-assert) rather than evidence of unintended duplication. Collapsing them would obscure the distinct intent of each test class.
